jobs.title: Cloud Finance Functional
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Oracle Finance Functional Consultant to lead end-to-end implementations and support Oracle Finance Cloud modules (AP, AR, GL, CE, EXP, FA).
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Finance Functional Consultant to lead end-to-end implementations and support Oracle Finance Cloud modules (AP, AR, GL, CE, EXP, FA). The role involves requirement gathering, system configuration, process mapping, and user training while collaborating with cross-functional teams. Candidates should have 5+ years of experience, with at least five full-cycle implementations. Strong communication, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment are essential. Oracle Finance Cloud certification is an added advantage.

jobs.title: Licensed Real Estate Agent
jobs.excerpt: Looking for a brokerage where you can build your business on your terms?
jobs.description:
Looking for a brokerage where you can build your business on your terms?

JBV Advisors welcomes licensed Florida real estate agents seeking a flexible, supportive brokerage affiliation. Whether you work in real estate full time, handle occasional transactions, or simply need a place to hang your license while balancing other commitments, there’s room for you here.

We welcome agents at every stage of their careers. You set your own goals and pace, without pressure to meet commission quotas.

What We Offer

  • Flexible scheduling for full-time and part-time agents
  • Independence to build and manage your business
  • A collaborative team and brokerage support
  • Access to resources and tools to support your transactions
  • A place to hang your license and pursue opportunities as they arise

Requirements

  • Active Florida real estate license
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage your clients and transactions independently
  • Professionalism and commitment to client service

Compensation

This is a commission-based opportunity. Transaction fees apply to sales and rentals, with enhanced commission opportunities available for qualifying higher-value residential and commercial transactions. The full fee and commission structure will be reviewed before you join.

Apply

Submit your résumé or a brief introduction telling us about your experience and what you’re looking for in a brokerage.
